build_sparse_voxel_map: build a sparse voxel map for a ScanNet scene using a multi-task agent model
evaluate_object_detection: evaluate predicted bounding boxes against ground truth with IoU thresholds of 0.25, 0.5, and 0.75
extract_instance_data: extract instance bounds, scores, and category IDs from the voxel map for evaluation
visualize_voxel_map: visualize the sparse voxel map using the open3d backend
run_scannet_scene_pipeline: run the full ScanNet scene pipeline via Hydra CLI to build, evaluate, and save the instance map
